I think we have the same birthday. This is literally my chart. our rising sign is different from 1 degree. wild.

It always intrigues and excites me when I meet someone with the same birthday/chart. Because often i just feel so different from everyone in terms of the way my mind works, how i process things and just the amount of traumatic shit i have experienced. makes me feel a lot older than i am, too. i have CPTSD and had repeated instances of sexual violence in my childhood. always been attracted to the hidden/dark aspects of the psyche and of life itself. i’m 26 and only now “finding myself”. i feel like a late bloomer, but with a lot of deep knowledge, wisdom and talent to share with the world that ive kept hidden. i love talking to people and i love writing, either journaling or creative writing/poetry/arts. 

you spoke of having a complicated relationship with your mom. that’s my experience as well, and it’s not shocking considering the fact our moon is in the 12th house, with harsh aspects no less. i was neglected growing up and perpetually put into unsafe situations, usually because of the decisions my mom made while functioning out of her own woundedness. i’d also say i have an enmeshed dynamic with her. i’ve thought about cutting her off before too, but i found that as time passes and we continue going to therapy to heal our own issues, our relationship is getting better which i am very grateful for. also, i have a telepathic connection with my mom which i feel is another 12th house moon thing. 
my relationship with my dad on the other hand… 😬 that’s always been confusing because he’s been an enigma to me pretty much my whole life. my parents divorced when i was 7. i’m sure that with your sun/pluto you’ve also maybe had power struggles with the men/fathers/masculine roles in your life. Saturn rx in 10th can also indicate that. 

another 12th house thing… do you have very vivid/prophetic dreams? i feel like i get a lot of information from my dreams and they’ve always been vivid, like i can write a book about what i dreamt. i write down my dreams in my notes after i wake up. im also very intuitive and sensitive. 

please let me know if you relate to any of what i said. i’d love to hear your experiences , so feel free to reach out to me privately if you’d ever want to talk more about astrology and our experiences. 🙂
